fields.label: Plan Key
fields.description: Stable identifier the app checks out with (e.g. standard-monthly). Lowercase, no spaces — it is the record name.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: Card title in the app. Plans sharing a title render as ONE card whose term tabs switch between them (monthly/yearly).

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Card copy shown under the title. Sell only what exists — no homework tool, no past papers (tiers proposal §3).

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Recurring = billed for [months]. One-Off Programme = bought once for the upcoming programme window below. Per Lesson = a once-off charge for one attended lesson.

fields.label: Price
fields.description: What checkout charges for this plan (the whole term for Recurring, the programme for One-Off, one lesson for Per Lesson). An ACTIVE plan must have a positive price — no invented fallbacks (#47). The per-student monthly partner rate stays in LMS Settings and substitutes on monthly plans for payer-capable partners (#23/#30).

fields.label: Months
fields.description: Coverage months for a Recurring plan (1 = monthly, 12 = yearly). Must be 0 for One-Off Programme and Per Lesson plans — they are not time subscriptions.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Only active plans appear in the app catalog and can be checked out.

fields.label: Assistant Chat
fields.description: Whether this plan includes the in-lesson chat assistant (the student's private chat lane). Defaults ON — existing and unspecified plans keep chat until the owner switches it off per plan.

fields.label: Holiday Access
fields.description: How much of the Holiday Programme this plan opens: the whole window (Full), only its first seven days (First Week), or none at all (None). Defaults Full — existing plans keep the whole programme. A One-Off Programme purchase is always Full for its window regardless.

fields.label: Programme Window Label
fields.description: One-Off Programme only: what the current window is called in the app (e.g. December Holiday Programme). Configurable copy, never hardcoded.

fields.label: Programme Window Start
fields.description: One-Off Programme only: first covered day of the UPCOMING programme window. A purchase buys the upcoming window at purchase time; update these dates for each new programme.

fields.label: Programme Window End
fields.description: One-Off Programme only: last covered day of the upcoming window. Checkout refuses once this date has passed until the next window is configured — a one-off never grants a past programme.
